Normalization: Source suffix after # identifies Sources entry; Sequence is one-based native observation index. Every measured expectation references its source row; native errors/status/body stay unchanged.

Owner 000000000000 maps to 123456789012; member 917546008205 maps to 222222222222. Native owner Delegated is represented by caller/root; native wildcard OrganizationAccountAccessRole by other/root. The member IAM user remains an owned least-privilege IAM user. These fixture actor substitutions are not new AWS measurements.
Bucket/AP/user names are deterministic fixture names; issued ARN/alias/user strings use Bind. CopySource boto3 dictionary is encoded into the Go SDK string form (AP ARN uses /object/key).

PutObject Body recipes contain exact native bytes. GetObject digests derive from recorded native response bodies, not emulator output. Native checksums/defaults unrelated to authority are not projected.
Local prerequisite rows are explicitly marked local-fixture, never represented as AWS observations. Reopen is local retained-backend verification of the same measured consumer outcome.
AP deny and delegation-removal propagation observations are retained only as uncertain source evidence, never replayed as bypass rules.
